markscheme.html:
D

At the moment of release, the pendulum bob has zero velocity, so its centripetal acceleration is zero. The net force in the radial direction (along the string) must therefore be zero. By resolving the gravitational force mg, its component along the string is mg cos(θ). This component is balanced by the tension T. Therefore, T = mg cos(θ). Using the trigonometric identity sin(90° - θ) = cos(θ), this corresponds to option D.
